player_intent: A standing dive keeps the gun supported near the chest during the opening motion, then lowers it smoothly into the prone firing posture instead of striking the floor immediately.
acceptance_rule: During a standing dive the stable chest weapon anchor retains at least 90 percent of its standing-to-prone height through the declared early phase, reaches prone by the end of the same 0.78-second CharacterBody3D action, keeps both hand contacts within their existing limits, and returns to the prone ready solver.

nodes.role: Consumes the saved phase curve as a presentation-only chest anchor during the committed dive.
Declares the single chest-carry presentation owner for committed mobility actions.
Keeps both palms connected to the rigid weapon after the chest anchor is resolved.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D dive duration, velocity, displacement, collision, and final posture
SOCOM camera, reticle, aim intent, and obstruction authority
server shot, damage, ammunition, and networking authority
fire recovery, reload, grenade, and ordinary locomotion animation ownership
existing trigger and support hand contact limits
visual_check: In res://main.tscn, run and press the dedicated dive control. Confirm the standing rifle remains chest-supported at the beginning, descends later into prone without a floor strike, both hands remain connected, and the player still covers the same distance in the same action time. Also test crouch-origin dive to confirm its proven contact-safe timing remains intact.

system_delta.reason: The canonical stable-chest weapon owner already had a dive phase curve, but the action-follow code used the raw animated torso pivot and bypassed it. Route that existing owner through saved phase data and keep movement untouched.

current.system: Chest-owned dive weapon following the raw animated torso pivot

candidate.system: Saved posture-aware stable-chest descent with bounded palm convergence and explicit prone recovery ownership
